classification.difficultyReason: Form two angle equations, solve for different coefficient-labelled unknowns and compare their values.

content.prompt: Which has the larger value, $f$ or $g$? Explain your reasoning.

spec.description: Two oblique straight lines with plain endpoints. Top sector has 130° without an arc; right and bottom sectors have arcs and labels 2g and 4f. The left sector is unlabelled.
spec.mathematics: Vertically opposite angles give 4f=130. Adjacent angles on a straight line give 130+2g=180. Algebraic labels have no printed degree symbols.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 130°, 2g and 4f are shown; f and g values belong to answers.

answer.worked:
Vertically opposite angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}4f&=130\\f&=\frac{130}{4}\\f&=32.5\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}2g&=180-130\\2g&=50\\g&=25\end{align*}$$
Since $32.5>25$, $f$ is larger.
